title: The Flow of Thought
frozenHeadings: The rules of the games of the mind
safeClaims: Thought can become a flow domain when symbols, rules, and challenge organize attention.
Intellectual flow is not reserved for professionals alone.
Language, history, science, and philosophy can all become sites of deep involvement.
Lifelong learning matters because the mind needs continuing challenges to stay alive and ordered.
supportLimits: Do not overclaim educational psychology or IQ theory not supported by the freeze.
Do not reduce thought to career achievement alone.
Do not imply that formal credentials are the gate to intellectual flow.
Keep philosophical references broad and practical rather than academic-display heavy.
